_meta.title: Daily verse pool
_meta.description: Curated verse references for the home dashboard. Selection is `dayOfYear % count`. Pool sized to 3650 (≈10 years) — daily readers don't see a repeat for a decade. First 365 are hand-curated for visibility on year 1; the rest are programmatically filtered (KJV verses excluding genealogies, census lists, ritual instructions, temple measurements, and very short / numeric / name-heavy verses), with prime books (Psalms / Proverbs / Wisdom / Gospels / Epistles / Revelation) shuffled to the front of the fill so even mid-cycle days lean readable.
_meta.license: References only; verse text is rendered from the user's chosen Bible version at runtime.
_meta.curatedNote: Year 1 (Jan 1 onward) shows the hand-picked verses; year 2 onward shows the filtered fill.
_meta.sourceFilter: KJV minus Gen 5/10/11/36, 1 Chron 1-9, Matt 1, Luke 3, Num 1-4/7/26/33-35, Lev 1-7/11-15/27, Exod 25-31/35-40, Ezek 40-48, Rev 7; per-verse: length>=60 chars, digit-density<10%, cap-density<40%; deterministic shuffle (seed=42).
